packageRules.description: Catch-all: one PR for every remaining non-major update, merged automatically once CI passes. Listed first because Renovate cascades — later rules override this grouping for the ecosystems below, while inheriting the automerge set here.
Vitest and its coverage provider are peer-versioned; bumping them in separate PRs makes each fail CI on its own.
Vite and its plugins move together.
React runtime packages must stay on the same version as each other.
Angular peer-versions the whole framework — a split bump will not install.
Capacitor core, CLI and platform packages ship in lockstep.
TypeScript on its own — a bump can surface new type errors across the module and deserves a dedicated review.
Majors are never grouped, never opened automatically and never automerged: each one waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, then gets its own PR to review by hand.
